result.instructions: Tools for Helpwise, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many conversations did we receive and close last week?"; "Show the newest conversations and whether each is open or closed."; "Find the contact Jane Smith and her recent conversations.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Helpwise data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run helpwise_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run helpwise_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run helpwise_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. helpwise_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: helpwise_list_conversations
tools.title: List conversations
tools.description: List conversations (threads) of one or more inboxes, newest first, with subject, snippet, tags, assignee, read/starred/closed flags and contact. Pick the folder with `folder` (default: all). Page with `next_page_token`. Inbox ids come from helpwise_list_inboxes. GET /conversations.

folder.description: Folder: all, assigned, unassigned, starred, snoozed, draft, sent, closed, spam, trash, scheduled.

tools.name: helpwise_get_conversation
tools.title: Get conversation
tools.description: One conversation with its messages, notes, drafts, assignment and contacts. Page long conversations with `page_token` from the previous reply. GET /inboxes/{inbox_id}/conversations/{conversation_id}.

inbox_id.description: Inbox (mailbox) id the conversation lives in.

page_token.description: Page token from the previous reply, for older messages.

tools.name: helpwise_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts (name, company, job title, emails, phones, id). Page with limit and offset. GET /contacts.

offset.description: How many results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: helpwise_search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts
tools.description: Search contacts by a name, email or phone term. Page with limit and offset. GET /contacts/search.

offset.description: How many results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: helpwise_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: One contact with emails, phones, company, custom fields and recent conversations. GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: helpwise_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: All tags (id, name, colour, parent, inbox). Use the ids with helpwise_apply_tags. GET /tags.

tools.name: helpwise_get_tag
tools.title: Get tag
tools.description: One tag by id. GET /tags/{id}.

tools.name: helpwise_get_report
tools.title: Overall report
tools.description: Overall and team-performance report for a date range: new/closed/assigned conversations (with change vs the previous period), inbound/outbound messages per day, busiest hour/day, average first response, response and resolution time, CSAT and per-agent performance. Optional inbox and tag filters. GET /reports.

start.description: Start, yyyy-mm-dd or yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss (a date alone means 00:00:00).

end.description: End, yyyy-mm-dd or yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss (a date alone means 23:59:59).

tag_ids.description: Only conversations with these tag ids.

tools.name: helpwise_get_tags_report
tools.title: Tags report
tools.description: Per-tag report for one inbox and a date range: conversations per tag (and share), open conversations, average response, first-response and resolution time. GET /inboxes/{inbox_id}/reports/tags.

start.description: Start, yyyy-mm-dd or yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss (a date alone means 00:00:00).

end.description: End, yyyy-mm-dd or yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss (a date alone means 23:59:59).

tools.name: helpwise_list_inboxes
tools.title: List inboxes
tools.description: List the account's inboxes (mailboxes) with id, name, address and type. Use the ids in the other tools. POST /mailboxes/list (V0).

tools.name: helpwise_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the team members (agents) with access to an inbox: id, name, email. Use the ids with helpwise_assign_conversation. POST /users/list (V0).

tools.name: helpwise_get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: The Helpwise user the API key belongs to (name, email, id). POST /users/me (V0).

tools.name: helpwise_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a new contact in Helpwise (name, company, job title, emails, phones, custom fields). Nothing is sent to the person. Creating the same email twice may create a duplicate. POST /contacts.

phone.description: Phone number with country code, e.g. +14155550123.

type.description: Helpwise phone type code, as a string (default "0").

id.description: Custom field id (from the Helpwise custom fields settings).

tools.name: helpwise_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: WRITE: change a contact's name, company, job title, emails, phones or custom fields. Helpwise updates with PUT, so this tool first reads the contact and sends the current values together with your changes; a list you pass (emails, phones, custom_fields) REPLACES the old list. Nothing is sent to the person. PUT /contacts/{id}.

emails.description: The full list of email addresses (replaces the current list).

phones.description: The full list of phone numbers (replaces the current list).

phone.description: Phone number with country code, e.g. +14155550123.

type.description: Helpwise phone type code, as a string (default "0").

custom_fields.description: Custom field values to set (replaces the current list).

id.description: Custom field id (from the Helpwise custom fields settings).

tools.name: helpwise_add_note
tools.title: Add note
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal note to a conversation. Visible to your Helpwise team only; it is not sent to the customer. Notes cannot be deleted through this API. POST /notes/add (V0).

tools.name: helpwise_assign_conversation
tools.title: Assign conversation
tools.description: WRITE: assign a conversation to a team member (user id from helpwise_list_users), or pass assigned_to 0 to unassign it. The assignee may be notified by Helpwise. POST /threads/assign (V0).

assigned_to.description: User id to assign to, or 0 to unassign.

tools.name: helpwise_close_conversations
tools.title: Close conversations
tools.description: WRITE: close up to 25 conversations (mark them done). They can be reopened with helpwise_reopen_conversations. Nothing is sent to customers. PUT /conversations/action/close.

tools.name: helpwise_reopen_conversations
tools.title: Reopen conversations
tools.description: WRITE: move up to 25 conversations back to the inbox (reopen closed ones). Nothing is sent to customers. PUT /conversations/action/moveToInbox.

tools.name: helpwise_apply_tags
tools.title: Apply tags
tools.description: WRITE: apply existing tags (ids from helpwise_list_tags) to up to 25 conversations. Tags can drive Helpwise automations. Applying a tag already present changes nothing. POST /tags/apply.

tools.name: helpwise_remove_tags
tools.title: Remove tags from conversations
tools.description: WRITE: take tags off up to 25 conversations. The tags themselves are not deleted. POST /tags/remove.

tag_ids.description: Tag ids to remove from them (1-10).

tools.name: helpwise_send_email
tools.title: Send email
tools.description: WRITE: SEND A REAL EMAIL from a Helpwise inbox to the given customer address(es). Irreversible; once sent it cannot be recalled. At most 10 recipients in total (to + cc), one message per call; never use it for lists or campaigns. This starts a new message (it is not a reply on an existing conversation). The body is plain text (blank line = new paragraph); it is sent as HTML. POST /emails/send_mail (V0).

inbox_id.description: Inbox (mailbox) id to send from (see helpwise_list_inboxes).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Helpwise
prompts.description: What you can do with Helpwise here, with example requests to try.
